---
title: "Sampling Without Replacement Should Be Called Sampling"
format: html
---

In what situation, where I'm interested in estimating the count of
black marbles in an urn, would I take out a marble and then put
it back in the urn? The convention that the default is sampling with replacement illustrates the tension
between simple theory and practical use. And that even in mathematical fields,
results are often driven by collective reasoning.
